Frequency Control and Dynamics (Part 1) Frequency Control and Dynamics (Part 1) Jarrad Wright National Laboratory of the Rockies March 2026 Photo by Josh Bauer, National Laboratory of the Rockies 61725 Frequency Principles Frequency Principles Direct Current (DC) Alternating Current (AC) • Good: • Good: –Converts AC to DC, transmits DC power over long distances, and inverts DC to AC – Can easily step-up and step-down voltages (usability) –Controls power flow on DC line to a specific value – Serialization is easy (many substations radial/meshed can (controllability) serve load) –Is economical for long distance transmission (overhead – Enables reduced current and losses at high voltages lines cheaper, lower losses) – Increased transfer capability with series compensation –Can operate close to thermal limits in almost all cases (reduce line reactance). –Provides direct control between regional AC grids • Bad: –Enables synchronous interconnection (60 Hz and 50 Hz – Limited maximum transfer megawatt (MW) capability AC systems can be interconnected) across longer distances (voltage stability — surge impedance loading, transient stability limits) –Capable of emergency power/black start – Subsynchronous resonance concerns if lines are series –Is short-circuit limited (controlled injection) compensated –Capable of power oscillation damping – Needs reactive power support for voltage regulation (shunt • Bad: capacitors/reactors, SVCs, STATCOMs) –Uneconomical for short distance transmission (substations more expensive) –Intermediate substations require multi-terminal DC (not prevalent—complexity). National Laboratory of the Rockies | 3 What Is the System Frequency? What Is the System Frequency? • Frequency is the rate at which AC systems oscillate (50/60 Hz). • Frequency is one of the two heartbeats of a power system: ◦ Frequency ◦ Voltage. • Frequency in an interconnection is the same (Southern African Power Pool, Eastern African Power Pool, etc.). • An interconnection can contain a number of control areas. National Laboratory of the Rockies | 4 What is the System Frequency? What is the System Frequency? • Actual frequency is the balance between supply and demand. Source:
